claim: The new latchedBoardH reset is keyed on a moveCount TRANSITION to 0, but latchedBoardH (unlike shrinkLatchCount) is written independently of moveCount — so any deal-to-deal hop with no move in between never resets it and the fresh deal inherits the previous deal's chrome-shrunk height for its entire life. Concrete repro, no rotation needed: tap 'Show me how to win' (showSolution -> deal() sets moveCount 0, demo bar appears, liveH drops ~43pt, latch = short), then tap Stop BEFORE pressing Start (the demo opens paused/not-started, so moveCount never leaves 0) -> restartDeal() -> deal() assigns moveCount = 0 over 0, .onChange(of: game.moveCount) does not fire (SwiftUI compares values; @Published firing is irrelevant), the demo bar disappears and liveH grows back, but latchedBoardH is still the short value. Same via Daily -> Play a challenge (DailyHUD up, latch short) -> make no moves -> New game (challengeDay nil, HUD gone, moveCount 0->0). The whole board is then sized for chrome that is not on screen: on 375x667 with a 13-card column that is fit=(364-32)/11.36=29 -> the 30pt clamp instead of 34pt cards, plus a permanent ~43-62pt dead strip under the tableau, for the rest of the deal. The comment at ContentView.swift:51-52 asserts the opposite ('Reset alongside shrinkLatchCount at moveCount == 0, so a HUD/demo bar appearing with a NEW deal re-latches at the correct (shorter) height'). Fix: reset latchedBoardH on a deal identity, not on a moveCount edge — e.g. bump a dealID in Game.deal() and .onChange(of: game.dealID), or additionally reset on .onChange(of: game.challengeDay) / demo-bar visibility.
note: CONFIRMED at code level (I traced deal()/restartDeal()/showSolution and the two onChange sites); the VISUAL magnitude is device- and column-dependent — on a 390x844 phone with tallest <= 12 the width bound still dominates and nothing shows. shrinkLatchCount does not have this hole because it is only ever WRITTEN when count != 0; latchedBoardH is written by the liveH observer at any moveCount, which is the asymmetry.

claim: latchedBoardH is scoped per-deal but is a function of the container size, and nothing invalidates it when the container size changes. CONFIRMED: it survives a portrait->landscape->portrait round trip untouched (only .onChange(of: game.moveCount) clears it). SUSPECTED failure: the portrait branch is selected by `geo.size.width > geo.size.height` (ContentView.swift:73), so if SwiftUI delivers interpolated root sizes during the rotation animation, every intermediate frame from 390x844 down to ~617x617 still renders the portrait branch and feeds liveH values as low as ~373 into the min-latch. Rotating out and back mid-deal would then leave the board pinned at the near-square height for the rest of the deal — with tallest=14 that is fit=(373-32)/11.09=30 (the clamp) instead of 41pt cards, a ~27% permanent shrink triggered by a gesture that should be a no-op. Cheap unconditional guard that also removes the doubt: `.onChange(of: geo.size) { latchedBoardH = 0 }` on the outer GeometryReader (or store the latch alongside the geo.size it was measured at). Verify by logging liveH in the onChange at ContentView.swift:156 and rotating in the simulator: if only the final size is ever delivered, close this as wontfix.
note: SUSPECTED, not confirmed — I did not run a rotation.
